messages:
Caroline H: Quick design review — trying to reduce vertical noise on the Usage page. Proposed: move invoice download to the right of the spend summary, compress per-project rows into denser cards, and replace large stacked bars with a single sparkline + numeric breakdown. Screenshot: https://placeholder.company/img.png :eyes:
Mike L: I like moving the download CTA up, but worried about discoverability. If it's top-right we should label it "Download invoice" clearly and keep an option to auto-download CSV. Should it be a primary or secondary button? :thinking:
Lucy G: Recommend primary CTA be visible only to billing owners; for others show "Request invoice". Also the token breakdown microcopy needs to say "tokens billed" not just "tokens" — finance folks get confused otherwise.
Ivan P: Accessibility note — if we move the CTA visually, update DOM order. Screen readers read top->bottom; ensure invoice button appears early in the DOM and has aria-label="Download invoice for account X". Also keyboard focus needs to land on it in one tab.
Tara S: Strong +1 for a compact table toggle. Proposal: default = medium density; add a small "Compact view" switch in the right rail. Keyboard focus styles need to be visible in compact mode (outline >= 3px).
Caroline H: Good call on microcopy. Lucy can you write two line options? Also want to avoid duplicating totals across header and cards — pick one canonical total to reduce cognitive load.
Lucy G: Option A: "Billed tokens (USD)"
Option B: "Charged tokens — includes discounts and credits"
Which is clearer?
Mike L: Option B feels more accurate but longer. Maybe show B in a hover tooltip and keep a short label in the UI (e.g., "Charged tokens").
Ivan P: Also check color contrast on the sparkline stroke at 1px; users on 125% zoom lose the line. Use >=4.5:1 for small UI strokes or add a patterned fill for low-vision users.
Tara S: For the per-project mini-cards: suggestion to show a tiny horizontal bar + numeric delta vs previous period; keep each card <=48px height so the page doesn't scroll too much on teams with many projects.
Caroline H: Dev notes — runtime team prefers continuous batching to not change telemetry events. If we change layout IDs, remember to update metrics mapping: `usage_panel_v2` -> `usage_panel_v3`. Can we get a quick analytics audit?
Mike L: I'll file an analytics ticket and paste the mapping in the ticket. Also let's A/B test header CTA vs row CTA at 10%/90% split to measure clicks and invoice downloads.
Lucy G: I'll draft the copy and update Figma. Link: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (frame: spend-panel-compact-v3).
design-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled tomorrow 11:00am PT. Please bring accessibility checklist and annotated Figma.
Caroline H: Thanks all. Quick consensus: move invoice CTA to header (but run A/B), add compact toggle, adopt microcopy B with tooltip, ensure DOM order + aria-labels, and tighten sparkline contrast. Lucy/Tara to own followups. :thumbsup:
